en: Character is like a tree and reputation like its shadow. The shadow is what we think of it; the tree is the real thing.
zh: 品格如树，名声如影。影子是别人眼中的它，树才是它本身。
line: Character is like a tree and reputation like its shadow. The shadow is what we think of it; the tree is the real thing. — Abraham Lincoln

word.ex: He will increase in strength and honor by struggling with adversity, which he will convert into prosperity.
word.exzh: 他会在与逆境的搏斗中变得更强大、更受尊敬，并把逆境化为顺境。
